## Checklist

- [ ] Design decisions trace back to expired patents / papers from [docs/01-prior-art.md](../docs/01-prior-art.md) (§3)

## Languages — read only if you touched docs

Docs are multilingual: English lives at the canonical paths, every other language mirrors the tree under `translations/<lang>/`. **Edit just ONE language — whichever you actually speak.** English is NOT required: right after the merge, the Translation sync bot translates your change into English and all other languages automatically.

- Edited one language of a doc → done, nothing else to do.
- Edited several languages of the same doc on purpose → say so here, the bot will not touch that doc.
- Figure text lives in `labels.json` (one section per language) — same rule: edit your section, the bot syncs the rest and regenerates the figures.
